description: This Java class, MidiDispatcher, is an Android utility class that manages dispatching MIDI data to multiple MidiReceiver instances. It subclasses MidiReceiver and maintains a thread-safe list of receivers, providing methods to connect/disconnect receivers and to send or flush MIDI messages.
external_methods: MidiReceiver.send(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiDispatcher
classes.description: A utility class that dispatches MIDI data to a list of MidiReceiver instances, handling connection management and message forwarding.

methods.name: getReceiverCount
methods.description: Returns the number of MidiReceiver instances currently connected to this dispatcher.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Provides a MidiSender object to connect or disconnect MidiReceivers.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver.onSend; forwards the MIDI message to all connected receivers, removing any that throw an IOException.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver.flush; calls flush on all connected receivers.

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: Connects a MidiReceiver, adding it to the list.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a MidiReceiver, removing it from the list.

calls: receiver.send(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)
